eternal-sea.name: Eternal Demon Sea
eternal-sea.rulesText: ① When deployed: discard 2 cards from the top of the opponent's deck. ② Speed; 2 sea: reveal one random card from the opponent's hand; this turn the opponent cannot use, summon, or deploy cards with the same name.

far-north-crown.name: Far North Crown
far-north-crown.rulesText: Equip an Ice Dragon Creature, +2 power. Once per game, Speed; Tap: when your life is 15 or less, put all of the opponent's Creatures on the bottom of the deck.

far-north-dragon-emperor-arthur.name: Arthur, the Far North Dragon Emperor
far-north-dragon-emperor-arthur.rulesText: ① When summoned, for each Ice Dragon Creature you control, one summon effect occurs. Each time, you may choose one opponent Creature and deal 5 damage to it. ② When this Creature deals damage to a Creature, deal damage equal to half the actual damage (rounded down) to the opposing player.

far-north-graveyard.name: Far North Graveyard
far-north-graveyard.rulesText: ① When deployed: tap this Land. ② Tap: add one cold or demon energy.

fatiao-warrior.name: Fatiao Warrior
fatiao-warrior.rulesText: ① When summoned or when attacking: deal 3 damage to one Creature the opponent controls.

frost-messenger.name: Frost Messenger
frost-messenger.rulesText: ① When summoned, you may reveal the top three cards of your deck, put one Ice Dragon card among them on top of the deck, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order. ② When destroyed, draw a card.

frost-soul.name: Frost Soul
frost-soul.rulesText: ① When summoned: if you have an Ice Dragon Creature on the field with an Aurora counter on it, you may draw a card.

frostmoon-gatekeeper.name: Frostmoon Gatekeeper
frostmoon-gatekeeper.rulesText: ① When summoned: place one frost gear counter on one Equipment you control. Each card can have at most one frost gear counter. When the equipped Creature attacks, draw a card.

frostmoon-guardian.name: Frostmoon Guardian
frostmoon-guardian.rulesText: When an opponent Creature attacks, you may pay 2 cold to cancel that attack. That Creature still counts as having attacked.

great-wave-thunder-array.name: Great Wave Thunder Array
great-wave-thunder-array.rulesText: ① When deployed: tap this Land. ② Tap: add one sea or thunder energy.

heavenly-beast.name: Heavenly Beast
heavenly-beast.rulesText: When summoned, reveal the top three cards of your deck; each thunder card causes you to gain 1 life. Choose one thunder Land and put it into your hand, then put the rest on the bottom of the deck in the specified order.

heavenly-divine-city.name: Aralaria's Ultimate Weapon, Heavenly Divine City
heavenly-divine-city.rulesText: When summoned: create one 1/1 Emissary token with no abilities.

heavenly-gate.name: Heavenly Gate
heavenly-gate.rulesText: ① When deployed: you gain 1 life, then draw a card. ② Main: sacrifice this Relic on the field or discard this card from your hand to add 1 thunder energy.

heavenly-gatekeeper.name: Heavenly Gatekeeper
heavenly-gatekeeper.rulesText: ① When blocking or destroyed: you gain 1 life, then draw a card.

heavenly-lance.name: Heavenly Lance
heavenly-lance.rulesText: Equip condition: none. The equipped Creature gets +1 power. ① While equipped; when attacking: you gain 1 life, then draw a card.

heavenly-land-envoy-reila.name: Reila, the Heavenly Land Envoy
heavenly-land-envoy-reila.rulesText: ① When summoned: reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose one thunder Land among them and put it into your hand, then put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.

heavenly-marquis-ivun.name: Ivun of the Heavenly Three Marquises
heavenly-marquis-ivun.rulesText: Once per game, when summoned, reveal the top eight cards of your deck; all Spell cards are put into your hand and the rest are exiled.

heavenly-marquis-laila.name: Laila of the Heavenly Three Marquises
heavenly-marquis-laila.rulesText: ① Speed: negate the effect of an opponent's Spell card that is about to be cast and discard that card. Then, exile this Creature.

heavenly-patrol.name: Heavenly Patrol Soldier
heavenly-patrol.rulesText: ① (once per turn for this effect) when Angel Emperor Aralaria gains a Charge counter, draw a card.

heavenly-seeker-yela.name: Yela, the Heavenly Seeker
heavenly-seeker-yela.rulesText: ① When summoned: reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose one Emissary Creature or thunder Relic from among them, other than Yela, the Heavenly Seeker, and put it into your hand, then put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.

hera-camp.name: Hera's Camp
hera-camp.rulesText: ① When the opposing player loses life, an opponent Creature takes damage, or its maximum life decreases, once per turn, draw a card. ② Tap: draw a card.

hera-empowerment.name: Hera's Spirit Charge
hera-empowerment.rulesText: Speed: during this turn, your Phantom Puppet Creatures get +1 power.

hera-ghostfire.name: Hera's Ghostfire
hera-ghostfire.rulesText: Speed: all opponent Creatures get -2/-2, and exile each Creature soul-destroyed by this effect.

hera-phantom-spell.name: Hera's Phantom Art
hera-phantom-spell.rulesText: Speed: special summon one Phantom Puppet Creature with a printed mana value less than 4 from your graveyard. During your main phase, it is less than 6 instead. This selection ignores characteristic and cost modifiers in the graveyard.

holy-energy-haste.name: Holy Energy Art · Speed
holy-energy-haste.rulesText: Main: draw a card from the bottom of your deck. Speed: you gain 1 life.

ice-dragon-call.name: Ice Dragon Call
ice-dragon-call.rulesText: Main: reveal the top three cards of your deck, put one Ice Dragon card among them into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order. If there is an Ice Dragon Creature on the field, do it again.

ice-dragon-staff.name: Ice Dragon Staff
ice-dragon-staff.rulesText: Equip an Ice Dragon Creature, +1 power. When the equipped Creature attacks, place one ice crystal counter on that Creature. Speed: remove two ice crystal counters from the equipped Creature to return one Creature the opponent controls to its owner's hand.

ice-ridge-lord.name: Lord of the Ice Ridge
ice-ridge-lord.rulesText: Ice Dragon Creatures you control with an Aurora counter on them take 1 less damage. Whenever an Ice Dragon Creature you control attacks, draw a card.

icewind-guardian.name: Icewind Guardian
icewind-guardian.rulesText: When summoned, place one Aurora counter on this Creature. When another Ice Dragon Creature you control becomes the target of an effect, you may change that target to this Creature.
